reader.decision: Approved: move the three schedules to UTC. Also open a ticket now for the idempotency key in `psp.charge`, and start the refund list next.
reader.decision_reason: The message traces the double charge to the repeated 02:30 on the fall-back day, and UTC removes that cause for all three jobs at a small cost. The message also says UTC does not cover a restart double fire, so the idempotency key is still needed for a job that moves money.

reconstruction.problem: `charge_renewals` is scheduled at 02:30 Europe/Berlin. On 25 October the clocks fell back, so 02:30 occurred twice, at 00:30 UTC and 01:30 UTC. `due_jobs` only checks a 60-second gap, and the last fire was 60 minutes earlier, so it fired again. `settle_renewals` had not yet moved `renews_on`, and `psp.charge` sends no idempotency key, so Payrail accepted the second charge for the same 212 subscriptions. `send_dunning` also fired twice and sent its 41 emails twice.
reconstruction.what_breaks: 212 subscribers were charged twice, and 424 `renewal_charges` rows were settled. Several customers got duplicate dunning emails. Support kept no record of who has been refunded. The same schedule would also skip the job on spring-forward day, when 02:30 does not exist.
reconstruction.fix: Switch the three schedules to UTC: `charge_renewals` to `30 0 * * *`, `send_dunning` to `45 0 * * *` and `settle_renewals` to `0 4 * * *`. Add the rule that every job uses `timezone: UTC` to `docs/scheduler.md`. The alternative is an idempotency key built from `sub.id` and `renews_on` in `psp.charge`. That key covers restarts but does not stop the duplicate emails.
reconstruction.cost: Jobs run at 02:30 Berlin in summer and 01:30 Berlin in winter, a one-hour shift in local fire time twice a year. UTC does not stop a double fire from a restart inside the matching minute, because `last_fired` is held in memory. The idempotency key costs a change to the `psp.charge` signature.

reader.closing_answer: Yes, I approve moving the three schedules to UTC. I also want the idempotency key in `psp.charge` tracked as a follow-up, because UTC does not cover a restart double fire. Do the refund list next, since support kept no record of who was refunded.
